summary: Well-structured PowerShell solution with solid GitHub Actions integration. Workflow correctly uses `shell: pwsh`, pinned checkout@v4, and least-privilege permissions. Scripts follow best practices: Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, explicit exit codes. Minor concern: uses `$PWD` instead of `$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE` (line 27) for path resolution—unreliable in some PowerShell contexts. Code is tight with clear function separation (ConvertTo-Hashtable→Get-MatrixCombination→New-BuildMatrix→Invoke-MatrixGenerator), good comments explaining why, and proper validation at each step. Fixture output format is parseable for test harnesses. Should pass actionlint and run under act. Production-ready with one minor robustness fix needed.
